name: Thakral Services (India) Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1983, Thakral Services (India) Ltd is in the business of sale of security equipment and maintenance.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
TSIL is engaged in the business of offering Electronic Security products and maintenance, which consists of CCTV, Access control, Fire Detection, Alarms, and Intrusion Alarms. In FY24, the company sold off the securities business to M/s.Thakral Innovations Pvt. Ltd.

pros: Debtor days have improved from 83.7 to 42.9 days.
cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -53.4% over past five years.
